negative regulation of striated muscle cell apoptosis

definition: Any process that decreases the rate or extent of striated muscle cell apoptotic process, a form of programmed cell death induced by external or internal signals that trigger the activity of proteolytic caspases whose actions dismantle a striated muscle cell and result in its death.
label: negative regulation of striated muscle cell apoptotic process
